notes: Job READCARD step STEP05: CBACT02C reads CardDemo's card master (the CARDDATA KSDS, carddata.txt) in key order and DISPLAYs each CARD-RECORD on SYSOUT between its START / END OF EXECUTION lines; it writes no file, so SYSOUT, RETURN-CODE and the abend are the outputs compared. Every input is the corpus's data. Derived from CardDemo (Apache-2.0; Copyright Amazon.com, Inc. or its affiliates): LICENSE and NOTICE here are the source's own.

faults.name: open-cardfile
faults.why: 35: OPEN of a file that is not present (IBM Enterprise COBOL for z/OS Language Reference, File status key values): 'ERROR OPENING CARDFILE' from 0000-CARDFILE-OPEN, 9910-DISPLAY-IO-STATUS, then 9999-ABEND-PROGRAM -> ABEND U0999

faults.name: open-cardfile-verified
faults.why: 97: OPEN successful, file integrity verified (IBM Enterprise COBOL for z/OS Language Reference, File status key values) -- a SUCCESSFUL open, but 0000-CARDFILE-OPEN accepts only '00', so the step abends (the program's defect) through 9910-DISPLAY-IO-STATUS's 9 arm, then 9999-ABEND-PROGRAM -> ABEND U0999

faults.name: cardfile-read-error
faults.why: 30: permanent I/O error (IBM Enterprise COBOL for z/OS Language Reference, File status key values) on the third card: 'ERROR READING ...' from 1000-CARDFILE-GET-NEXT after two cards are displayed, 9910-DISPLAY-IO-STATUS, then 9999-ABEND-PROGRAM -> ABEND U0999

faults.name: cardfile-early-end
faults.why: 10: end of file (IBM Enterprise COBOL for z/OS Language Reference, File status key values) after two cards: END-OF-FILE is set, the file is closed and the step ends normally with what it has displayed

faults.name: cardfile-status-9
faults.why: 9x: implementor-defined condition (IBM Enterprise COBOL for z/OS Language Reference, File status key values): 1000-CARDFILE-GET-NEXT -> 9910-DISPLAY-IO-STATUS's non-numeric / 9 arm, then 9999-ABEND-PROGRAM -> ABEND U0999

faults.name: close-cardfile
faults.why: 30: permanent I/O error (IBM Enterprise COBOL for z/OS Language Reference, File status key values) closing CARDFILE after every record is displayed: 'ERROR CLOSING ...' from 9000-CARDFILE-CLOSE, 9910-DISPLAY-IO-STATUS, then 9999-ABEND-PROGRAM -> ABEND U0999

entries.why: #4316 unproven ports: reaches executeCbact02c, the service's no-argument entry (the generated controller's), which runs the step as runBatch(List.of(), null) and returns its RETURN-CODE (#4342): CBACT02C takes no PARM and opens its files through the DD names it declares, so the step it runs is the COBOL's
